# CodePlaced Full Technical Documentation — LLMS-FULL.txt

## Organization Information
- Name: CodePlaced
- Official URL: https://codeplaced.com
- Description: Modern technology partner building scalable digital products, cloud data platforms, and growth systems.
- Founders: Manya Tyagi (Founder & CEO) and Gaurav Shokhanda (Co-Founder & CTO).

## Services Breakdown

### 1. App & Web Development
- Cross-Platform Mobile Apps (iOS & Android) in React Native and Flutter.
- Web Applications in Next.js 15+ (App Router, Server Components, Turbopack) and React 19.
- Custom Backend Systems: High-concurrency Node.js, Python FastAPI, Java Spring Boot.
- Enterprise Multi-Tenancy SaaS architectures with billing, auth (OAuth2/SAML), and multi-region deployment.
- E-Commerce Engineering: Headless Shopify Storefronts, custom WordPress/WooCommerce solutions.
- API Design & Third-Party Integrations: REST, GraphQL, WebSockets, payment gateways (Stripe, Razorpay).

### 2. Data Engineering & Analytics
- Automated ETL/ELT Pipelines: Python, dbt, Apache Airflow, Mage, Prefect.
- Cloud Warehouses & Lakehouses: Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Databricks, AWS Redshift.
- Medallion Architecture: Bronze (raw immutable ingestion), Silver (conformed & validated), Gold (dimensional star schemas).
- Business Intelligence: Microsoft Power BI (DAX, incremental refresh, enterprise RLS) and Google Looker Studio.
- Real-Time Telemetry & Event Streams: Kafka, ClickHouse, Redis Streams.

### 3. Digital & Social Marketing
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & Search Engine Optimization (SEO).
- Paid Acquisition: Meta Ads Manager, Google Search & Performance Max, LinkedIn Campaign Manager.
- High-Impact Content Creation: Copywriting, technical thought leadership, graphic design, and video production.
- Attribution & Analytics: GA4, Server-side Google Tag Manager (sGTM), Meta Conversion API (CAPI).

## Delivery Lifecycle: From Strategy To Execution
1. 01 Discover: Technical requirements gathering, user persona definition, and business KPI alignment.
2. 02 Design: System architecture blueprints, data schemas, interactive UI/UX wireframes, and prototypes.
3. 03 Build: High-velocity agile 2-week sprints with clean version-controlled commits and weekly demo validation.
4. 04 Optimize: Automated QA validation, load testing, zero-downtime deployment, continuous telemetry, and SLA maintenance.
